title: SQL Developer – AI Prompting & Context Engineering
description:
This is a dual role, split between approximately 60% AI-assisted development and agent orchestration, and 40% SQL Server development supporting large-scale data migration. You’ll work within the development team and report to the Software Manager, combining practical AI skills with strong SQL expertise to deliver reliable, efficient solutions.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Assisted Development & Agent Orchestration (c. 60%)

  • Use AI coding assistants, such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, across the development lifecycle, including code generation, refactoring, testing, documentation and review.

  • Build and maintain effective prompts, system instructions, reusable skills and context to produce consistent, reliable AI outputs.

  • Design and orchestrate agents and multi-agent workflows, including task decomposition, tool use, agent hand-offs and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

  • Connect agents to internal systems, databases and APIs, for example through MCP or function calling.

  • Evaluate AI output for accuracy, regression, cost and latency, and refine workflows based on results.

  • Apply appropriate safeguards for data privacy, security and hallucination risk, particularly when customer or school data is involved.

  • Identify and prototype opportunities to apply AI to development and data migration, and share best practice by supporting and coaching colleagues.

SQL Server & Data Migration (c. 40%)

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable SQL Server T-SQL solutions and related tools for data cleansing, migration and reconciliation.

  • Provide database performance-tuning expertise for internal and third-party systems, using AI tooling where appropriate.

  • Define technical requirements with non-technical colleagues in the Data Migration Team, and work with third parties to understand their software and support migration projects.

  • Manage SQL Server database environments used for data migration, including backup and recovery in test environments.

  • Prepare and expose data safely for agents and AI workflows, using AI to support SQL query generation, code review and optimisation.

  • Plan and prioritise work independently, managing tasks against project timelines and requirements.

The Ideal Candidate

  • You’ll combine hands-on AI-assisted development skills with substantial SQL Server experience. You’ll be curious and adaptable, communicate clearly, and use good judgement to assess AI-generated output rather than accepting it uncritically.

  • Demonstrable experience using AI coding tools and writing effective prompts, with practical examples of workflows or agents you have built.

  • Substantial SQL programming experience and strong knowledge of the techniques and capabilities of Microsoft SQL Server 2017 or later.

  • A strong grounding in data modelling, data management and data manipulation, alongside Git, version control and attention to detail.

  • The ability to investigate problems independently, collaborate with colleagues and communicate clearly in writing and in person.

Essential Skills

Practical experience with AI coding assistants and strong prompting skills, supported by examples.

Strong SQL Server T-SQL development and performance tuning, including experience supporting SQL Server in a large-scale environment.

Experience with Git and version control.

Excellent teamwork, communication and documentation skills.

Desirable Skills

Experience building agents or multi-agent workflows using Claude Code, MCP or similar frameworks.

Familiarity with LLM APIs, evaluation approaches and prompt testing.

Scripting or programming experience in Python or a similar language.

Awareness of AI data protection and security considerations.

A reasonable understanding of operating systems, infrastructure and networking.

title: Business Analyst (m/w/d) - auch für Berufseinsteiger
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Wir investieren viel in Digitalisierung und erstellen selbst leistungsfähige und sehr individualisierte Softwaretools für mehr als 1000 aktive User:innen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Dresden suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Business Analyst (m/w/d) mit starkem Fokus auf Künstliche Intelligenz (KI). In dieser Rolle arbeitest Du täglich intensiv mit KI-gestützten Tools und nutzt diese aktiv, um Anforderungen zu analysieren, Lösungen zu konzipieren und umzusetzen. KI ist ein fester Bestandteil unserer Arbeitsweise und kein Zusatz:

  • Analyse bestehender Prozesse im Unternehmen (z.B. Kundenservice, Marketing, Werkstatt, interne Abläufe)
  • Identifikation von Möglichkeiten zur Digitalisierung und Automatisierung
  • Einsatz und Test von KI-Tools, um Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten
  • Aufbau von Automationen und digitalen Workflows
  • Umsetzung von KI-gestützten Lösungen gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung und dem KI-Team
  • Testen neuer Technologien und Tools im Bereich KI
  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung bestehender Prozesse


Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. Wirtschaft, Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Sehr gutes analytisches und strukturiertes Denkvermögen
  • Interesse an KI, Digitalisierung und Automatisierung
  • Freude daran, neue Tools auszuprobieren und praktische Lösungen umzusetzen
  • Selbständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Neugier und Lernbereitschaft
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C2-Niveau (GER) sind für die Ausübung dieser Position erforderlich

Umfangreiche Vorerfahrung im Bereich KI ist nicht erforderlich. Wichtig ist, dass du schnell lernst, Dinge ausprobierst und Lösungen entwickelst.


Wir bieten dir

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und einem kleinen KI-Team
  • Viele praktische Projekte statt theoretischer Konzepte
  • Schnelle Umsetzung von Ideen
  • Die Möglichkeit, dich schnell im Bereich KI, Automatisierung und Digitalisierung weiterzuentwickeln

title: Junior Digital Assets Operations Analyst
description:
Application URL
https://omegadg.com/work/remoteok

Omega Enterprises is an international digital-assets company focused on cryptocurrency markets, market intelligence, and data-based financial operations. We are expanding our team and looking for motivated people who would like to build practical knowledge of digital markets and develop their analytical skills.

This is an entry-level opportunity designed for candidates who are interested in cryptocurrency, financial markets, and working with market information. Previous employment in the crypto industry is not necessary. New team members receive onboarding, training, and ongoing support from experienced colleagues.

What You'll Do

  • Follow daily developments across cryptocurrency and digital-asset markets.
  • Assist the team with routine operational and analytical activities.
  • Track changes in prices, trading activity, liquidity, and other relevant indicators.
  • Gather information from internal and external market-data sources.
  • Maintain organized records and prepare concise internal reports.
  • Summarize market observations for team discussions.
  • Take part in regular training, feedback sessions, and team meetings.
  • Complete structured tasks under the guidance of more experienced team members.

What You'll Get

  • Fully remote working arrangement.
  • Flexible day-to-day workflow.
  • Structured onboarding for people new to the crypto industry.
  • Training in basic market-analysis and digital-asset tools.
  • Access to practical market information and analytical resources.
  • Regular feedback and guidance from a mentor.
  • A clear path for developing toward more advanced analytical responsibilities.
  • Opportunity to work within an international digital-assets team.

The Person We're Looking For

  • Are genuinely interested in cryptocurrency, financial markets, or market analytics.
  • Enjoy learning new tools and working with structured information.
  • Pay attention to detail when handling data and written tasks.
  • Can follow procedures and instructions consistently.
  • Are dependable, organized, and comfortable working independently.
  • Have English proficiency around B2 or higher, sufficient for professional tools, market information, and training materials.

Position Details

  • Position: Junior Digital Assets Operations Analyst
  • Work format: Remote
  • Experience: Entry level / training provided
